label: Straight Welt 2.5 cm
description: At 2.5 cm the straight welt breast pocket represents the most widely used English standard, balancing visibility with formality. It sits precisely in the sweet spot between the ultra-narrow and the wider Italian welt, making it the default reference point for most British bespoke houses and many quality ready-to-wear makers. The opening is left completely empty so the full 2.5 cm depth of the welt reads clearly against the chest, its top and bottom edges parallel along the whole length.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
